|quest_reward4_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Blight''' is a [[channelling]] [[spell]] that deals stacking [[chaos]] [[damage over time]] to all enemies in the [[Area of effect|area]] in front of the caster. Enemies who weren't affected by the damage over time are also [[hinder]]ed for a short duration. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''[[Damage over time]]''': Modifiers to [[spell]], [[chaos damage]], and [[damage over time]] affect the damage over time component of this spell. * '''[[Area of effect]]''': As Blight inflicts debuff stacks instead of dealing damage over time directly, increasing or decreasing the area of effect works as expected, but area '''damage''' (from e.g. {{il|Concentrated Effect Support}}) does not apply. * Blight does not [[hit]] and therefore cannot be supported by added damage supports such as {{il|Added Chaos Damage Support}} and cannot confer the effects of supports such as {{il|Blind Support}} or {{il|Hextouch Support}}. Additionally, on hit effects such as [[Leech]], [[poison]], or [[life gain on hit]] will not occur while using Blight. Despite not hitting, Blight will break pots, baskets, cairns, etc. within its area of effect. * See [[Channelling]] for more information. * Blight and Vaal blight both count towards the maximum limit of 20 debuffs per monsters. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Chaos
